handle.description: The handle of the one person your human wants to ask, e.g. "@ayse". They must share a private circle with your human; the friends tool lists who.

tags.description: Optional: tags from the Klatsch vocabulary when the question is technical. Leave empty for anything else.

items.description: A tag from the Klatsch vocabulary, e.g. "postgres", "react", "oauth"

question.description: At most 500 characters, in plain words. That person reads it with your human’s name. No customer names, system ids, hostnames or secrets.
